subject: order of Theta when generating a response-matrix

messages.author: 0a0b6b49c023d7a6
messages.subject: order of Theta when generating a response-matrix
parts:
Dear Phil or who might be able to answer,

In my research, I'm using simdata() to generate response matrices in the following way

simdata(a=a,  d,  N=40000,  itemtype = "3PL", guess = c, Theta = Theta) 

where the item length is 40 and Theta is following a standard normal distribution. 

The question is now if the first row in the response matrix matches the first value in Theta?

Or do they get sorted in some way? It seems to me that if I estimate the Thetas from the response matrix using fscores() the estimate and true value don't match very well. Of course, the should not be the same since it is an estimate but I don't see any correlation at all. I hope my question was understandable.

Regards and thanks,

Jonas

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: order of Theta when generating a response-matrix
parts:
Yes, each row of observed responses corresponds to the respective row in Theta. Regarding your question about matching, does your Theta input have similar scaling properties with the identification of the model (e.g., is it scaled to have means of 0 and variance of 1, which matches the identification constraints in mirt?). Point estimates are never going to be perfect, of course, but they should generally agree with the simulated theta values (e.g., should correlate quite well, and the precision of the thetas measured close to the regions of higher density should be measured better given how the model is estimated). HTH.

Phil
